data.description:
## What
Write failing tests asserting that every dispatch site of dso:red-team-reviewer specifies a mode parameter, preventing silent inheritance of inference-challenge behavior at existing Phase E story-review dispatch.

## Test file
tests/scripts/test-red-team-reviewer-dispatch-mode.sh

## Test cases
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md dispatch block for dso:red-team-reviewer includes a 'mode:' parameter (e.g., 'mode: story_review' or 'mode: preplanning')
- No dispatch of dso:red-team-reviewer in any skill file omits the mode parameter (grep for 'dso:red-team-reviewer' dispatch blocks, assert each has 'mode:' nearby)
- Test is scoped to files in plugins/dso/skills/ only

## Gate
RED — tests must FAIL before dispatch sites are updated
data.title: RED: test all red-team-reviewer dispatch sites specify mode explicitly
